Surreal

sur-REEL — literally 'beyond real'; a surreal moment feels like it's floated outside of reality entirely. · adjective

Hear It

What It Means

Surreal is bizarre or unbelievable; having a strange, dreamlike quality.

Standing at the edge of the enormous canyon at sunrise, she said the view felt completely surreal.

Worked Example

A young violinist who has practiced alone in her bedroom for ten years is suddenly invited to perform on stage with the exact orchestra she has listened to on recordings her whole life, and she can barely process that it's actually happening.

A moment so strange and dreamlike that it barely feels real, even while it's happening, is exactly what surreal means. Unlike 'exciting,' which is a feeling, surreal specifically describes something bizarre enough to seem unreal.

How Surreal Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

dreamlike

dreamlike: having the strange, unreal quality of a dream

bizarre

bizarre: very strange or unusual

unreal

unreal: not seeming real; hard to believe

Antonyms

ordinary

ordinary: normal, not unusual

mundane

mundane: commonplace and dull; lacking excitement

How Strong Is It? — strange → bizarre → surreal

strange vs. surreal

strange vs. surreal: Strange is milder and more general than surreal — something strange is simply odd, while surreal specifically feels like it belongs in a dream, bizarre enough to defy belief.

bizarre vs. surreal

bizarre vs. surreal: Bizarre can feel even more extreme than surreal: surreal often has a dreamlike, almost pleasant strangeness, while bizarre can describe something disturbingly or shockingly odd.

Build the Word

The pieces

prefix — sur-

prefix — sur-: above, beyond (French)

root — -real-

root — -real-: real, actual (Latin (res, 'thing'))

Put it together

Put it together: French sur- (above, beyond) combined with réel (real) to form surréel, coined for the Surrealist art movement of the 1920s. Something surreal, at its root, goes beyond ordinary reality into something dreamlike and bizarre.
